leadText: Fun Pokémon Names (Korean: 재미있는 포켓몬 이름들 Jaemi-itneun Poketmon Ireumdeul) is an ending theme for the Korean SBS dub of the original series. It used footage from Riding on Lapras. It is unknown when exactly this ending theme was used, though it was used as the ending of EP215.
plainText:
Fun Pokémon Names (Korean: 재미있는 포켓몬 이름들 Jaemi-itneun Poketmon Ireumdeul) is an ending theme for the Korean SBS dub of the original series. It used footage from Riding on Lapras. It is unknown when exactly this ending theme was used, though it was used as the ending of EP215.

==Ending animation==
Inside an empty room a painting hangs on the wall, on the painting is a picture of , , , and riding on . The painting is moving, and depicts the group riding Lapras throughout the Orange Islands. As they ride across the ocean flies overhead breathing fire. Gradually, the day turns to dusk.

==Trivia==
A song with the same melody but with lyrics featuring titled 디지디지 Digi Digi was released on the OST album for the Korean dub of in 2001. Both series were broadcast on SBS and had their music produced by Bang Yongseok of Hollywood Manner.
